scenario.title: Population distribution by continent
scenario.query: Retrieve visualization guidelines relevant to this chart and intent, aiming to improve the visualization for a general news reader audience.
scenario.designer_intent: The map is meant as an entry point to help readers understand the visualizations below it.

guideline.title: Use direct labels, not legends
guideline.description: Prefer direct labels to reduce cognitive load and scanning back-and-forth between marks and a legend.
guideline.body:
## The Advice <!-- role: advice -->
Label marks directly when feasible.

## Why <!-- role: reason -->
Legends force eye travel and increase errors.

guideline.title: Use consistent color encoding
guideline.description: Keep color mappings stable across views so readers can carry meaning forward.
guideline.body:
## The Advice <!-- role: advice -->
Assign a semantic meaning to each color and keep it consistent.

## Checks <!-- role: checks -->
Verify identical categories use identical colors.
